overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive medical benchmark (CMB) for evaluating LLMs in Chinese medical contexts. It evaluates both multiple-choice question answering (objective evaluation) and multi-turn dialogue generation (subjective evaluation). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and clarification of which metrics belong to which evaluation type. The paper uses both automatic metrics (accuracy for MCQs) and LLM-as-judge evaluation (GPT-4 scoring for dialogue responses).
